allocation_impact: Above ground (floor <= 7) floors 0..7 (8 floors); underground the observer floor +/- 2, clamped at 15 (5 floors, fewer at 14 and 15). Tiles beyond the floor rule are not candidates; never an error. Not configurable.
boundary_tests: floor 10 sees 8..12; floor 14 sees 12..15; floor 15 sees 13..15
